prompt: How many letters long is the title of the first movie composed by the composer of the first American Godzilla movie?
answer:
The composer of the first American *Godzilla* film (1998) was David Arnold. His first film score was for *The Young Americans*.

Ignoring spaces, **“The Young Americans” has 17 letters**.
